answer_1.quote: It is composed of 7 major tasks to evaluate LLMs' ability to understand both short and long dependency content.
answer_1.outputs: Summaries, answers to questions, filled cloze masks, timeline reordering sequences, numerical calculations, and reasoning outputs.

answer_2.quote: Automatic evaluation We adopt Bleu , Rouge , Meteor score and Bert Score as automatic evaluation metrics, which compute n-gram matching and semantic similarity for generative tasks. Exact Match and Partial Match are employed for cloze.

answer_3.quote: GPT4-as-judgment We follow to use GPT4 as a reliable substitute for human evaluation.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation Human in the loop is necessary for LLM evaluation for reference, especially for free text generation tasks. We manually inspect the accuracy of ground truthted answers being consistent with the groundtruth for some models/tasks.
answer_4.guideline: Manual inspection of generated outputs against ground truth for accuracy
